CycleTwin_VIT_pitch_deck_v8.pptx.ppt/slides/slide2.xml: The forecasting question | 02 | Can a system flag a likely delayed or absent ovulation early in a cycle, while showing uncertainty and limits? | • | Target: synthetic anovulation or ovulation after cycle day 21 | • | Forecast points: cycle days 10, 14 and 18 | • | Decision-support framing; no diagnostic or reproductive-planning use
CycleTwin_VIT_pitch_deck_v8.pptx.ppt/slides/slide3.xml: PMOS is a multi-system condition | 03 | Polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS; PCOS/PCOD) | The project frames the problem across reproductive and metabolic signals. The synthetic build currently evaluates only a reproductive-axis proxy. | Terminology follows Teede et al., The Lancet, 2026. The simulated phenotype labels are not diagnostic criteria.
CycleTwin_VIT_pitch_deck_v8.pptx.ppt/slides/slide4.xml: Why a digital-twin framing | 04 | Planned design | • | Reproductive follicle and ovulation dynamics | • | Metabolic glucose dynamics | • | Shared insulin-resistance latent with reverse cycle coupling | Current build | • | Stochastic synthetic cycle generator | • | Fixed risk score and temperature coverline heuristic | • | Simplified coupled twin shown in dashboard; not calibrated
CycleTwin_VIT_pitch_deck_v8.pptx.ppt/slides/slide5.xml: Data fusion and sensor tiers | 05 | Tier 0 | Period logs | › | Tier 1 | + resting HR* | › | Tier 2 | + nightly temp | › | Tier 3 | + CGM windows | › | Tier 4 | + EHR labs | Implemented evaluator: neutral period-only score; tier 1 uses resting-heart-rate offsets; tier 2 adds nightly temperature. | * Other wearable streams are generated but not fused. CGM display is synthetic only; E2 and EHR tiers are not evaluated.
CycleTwin_VIT_pitch_deck_v8.pptx.ppt/slides/slide6.xml: Synthetic data and leakage control | 06 | • | 1,200 synthetic patients × 6 cycles per generator seed | • | Three fresh seeds: 97, 101, 103 | • | Patient-level split: 70% train, 15% validation, 15% held-out test | • | No personal exports, credentialed data or external health records | The generator carries latent traits and noisy observations; the evaluator separates patients across partitions.
CycleTwin_VIT_pitch_deck_v8.pptx.ppt/slides/slide7.xml: Forecast model | 07 | Risk score | • | Tier 0: neutral baseline | • | Tier 1: resting-heart-rate offset | • | Tier 2: temperature rise relative to an early-cycle baseline | Ovulation-day estimate | • | Temperature coverline heuristic | • | Fallback: forecast day + 10 | • | Dashboard twin is separate and uncalibrated; no EKF | Conformal coverage is not reported. All settings are simulator assumptions.
CycleTwin_VIT_pitch_deck_v8.pptx.ppt/slides/slide8.xml: Safety and abstention | 08 | Dashboard safety rules | • | Review for thyroid/prolactin flags | • | Abstain for contraception and pregnancy-related states | • | Abstain for age and sensor completeness conditions | • | Dashboard shows a synthetic risk-coverage diagnostic | Current status | G2 dashboard implements explicit abstention guards. Safety performance and conformal coverage are not evaluated.
